product_launches.description: Seafood Souq expanded its SFS Fisheries digital traceability platform from Sharjah to Fujairah, marking the system’s first deployment in the emirate to digitize fish landings and catch verification.

overview_description.description:
Seafood Souq is an impact-focused digital ecosystem for the global seafood market, providing trade and industry leading full supply chain traceability technology with Data/Insights. Seafood Souq operates across the globe through regional headquarters that support sourcing and sales as well as SFS Trace implementation for some of the world's leading fisheries and retail brands.

Seafood Souq’s focus on a transparent and traceable seafood industry was recognized by the United Nations and the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission

product.name: SFS Trace
product.description: A seafood supply-chain traceability platform that captures, shares, and tracks product data from catch or harvest through processing and distribution.

product.name: SFS Fisheries
product.description: A fisheries management platform that digitises vessel operations, landing data, catch reporting, and compliance processes for small-scale and industrial fisheries.

product.name: SFS Audit
product.description: An independent seafood traceability verification service that reviews supply-chain documentation, validates sourcing information, and identifies traceability risks.

product.name: SFS Trade
product.description: A seafood trading and marketplace service that connects producers with buyers while supporting transactions, compliance, quality control, logistics, and traceable sourcing.
